top_signals.title: Treasury Wine Shares Soar After Moves to Tackle Excess US Supply
top_signals.summary: Australian vintner Treasury Wine Estates Ltd. saw its shares jump to an eight-month high after announcing a A$558.4 million ($395 million) post-tax writedown to tackle supply chain problems in its US market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Myspace eyes comeback as an 'antidote' to social media fatigue — but it may be a long shot
top_signals.summary: "Excitement about Myspace's relaunch reflects nostalgia for a more analog time, when algorithms were less dominant in our lives," an analyst told CNBC.
